independence_design.encoding: CNF reduction (Tseitin transformation of variables and logic constraints)
independence_design.third_path_validation: A separate Python check_witness validation function verifying the returned SAT assignment satisfies the original raw JSON constraints

sat_reducibility_mapping.domain_encoding: One-hot boolean variables per domain value for each variable name, plus exactly-one constraint
sat_reducibility_mapping.triad_closure_encoding: Clausified cycle constraint: for variables A, B, C, if A and B are active (not 0), C must not be 0
sat_reducibility_mapping.coupling_encoding: Clausified equivalence or implication clauses representing allowed_pairs transition table
sat_reducibility_mapping.projection_encoding: Unary unit clauses forcing the variable's value to belong to the allowed_values set
sat_reducibility_mapping.composition_encoding: Implication clauses mapping pairs of input values to composition outputs
